entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Andreas Walser was a Swiss painter. He was born in Chur and moved to Paris at the age of 20 to become more involved in the art world and "to become completely and utterly French". Many of his works were produced under the influence of drugs. He died in Paris aged 22.
